name: sessionsift
description: Local-first Codex session profiler and workflow analyzer
author: Lance Sandino

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-mod GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build go build -o dist/sessionsift ./src/cmd/sessionsift
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:web && npm run build:web && npm run test:go
scripts.test:go: GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-mod GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out && GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-mod GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build go tool cover -func=coverage.out | awk '/^total:/ { gsub("%", "", $3); if ($3 + 0 < 85) exit 1; print "Go statement coverage: " $3 "%" }'
scripts.test:mutation:unit: vitest run --config src/web/vite.config.ts components/sessionFilters.test.ts components/timelineWindow.test.ts components/timelineJourney.test.ts
